review.finding: An import that rebinds a captured name kept the same hash because _order left imports out. Fixed in 75d291ab (imports ordered when a reached name is rebound), test added.
The module-level statement guard let a call at import through (an assignment whose value calls setattr). Fixed in 75d291ab: no call in a module-level statement of a promise file.
The order of every reached binding was hashed, so reordering unrelated helpers moved the hash. Fixed in 75d291ab: order is hashed only when a reached name is bound more than once.
An annotated reset of pytestmark was not a reset and covers_of kept ids before a reset. Fixed in 75d291ab.
The AC11 aggregation check used .get on the stub state. Fixed in 75d291ab: keys indexed directly.
lock_problems compared the whole entry and lock_key accepted a path leaving the repository. Fixed in 75d291ab: acs and hash only, '..' refused.
The statement guard is one long boolean; not changed (rejected-with-reason: the guard is test code and readable enough, a shared helper would couple the meta test to a private function).

notes: Stage-2 reviewed commit b08bbe375; the findings were fixed in 75d291ab and re-checked by the Stage-3 reviewer.
